title: Reverse Callaway chart adjustment row to 2, 1, 0, -1, -2

requirements.text: Update the Callaway chart “Adjustment” header row (columnAdjustments) so the five values are exactly: 2, 1, 0, -1, -2 (left-to-right) for both the 18-hole and 9-hole grid charts, including the shipped defaults and any normalization/migration logic that currently forces a different order.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Admin Callaway Chart Editor, the Adjustment row displays (left-to-right) 2, 1, 0, -1, -2 when charts are using shipped defaults.
When loading a previously-saved chart whose columnAdjustments are in the opposite order (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), the app normalizes it to the new required order (2, 1, 0, -1, -2).
Callaway scoring calculations use the updated adjustment values (i.e., results change consistently with the new columnAdjustments order).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Do not change the grossScore/worstHoles grid cell values (only the adjustment row values/order).
No backend Callaway chart changes are included in this request.
